title: Ancient Ceramic Mask
description: A single ornate ceramic mask with closed eyes and slightly parted lips, featuring a weathered face in earthy tones with flowing blue and purple glaze patterns. The top and side edges display bands of ancient script-like symbols against a dark background.
prompt: Highly detailed ancient ceramic mask with closed eyes and serene expression, weathered earthy brown surface with flowing abstract patterns of blue and purple glaze dripping across the cheeks and forehead, golden accents, bands of mysterious ancient script along the top and side borders, realistic ceramic texture with subtle cracks and patina, dramatic studio lighting on dark background
